name: com.profblu.siami/siami
title: Siami
description: Snow, ski, kite, diving and surf spots: today's conditions, forecast, schools, shops and events.

tools.name: find_spots
tools.description: Lists Siami's snowboard, ski, kitesurf, diving and surf spots by sport, country and area (region, province, island or town), alphabetically, with the place, the country, the sports of each spot and its page. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

sport.description: The sport: snow (snowboard), ski, kite (kitesurf), diving or surf.

country.description: A country: its name in English, Spanish or Italian (“Argentina”, “Spain”, “Italia”) or its ISO code (“AR”).

area.description: A region, province, island or town (“Bariloche”, “Tenerife”, “Valais”, “Mar del Plata”).

query.description: Words in the spot's name or place.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish, the default), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: get_spot
tools.description: One spot's page on Siami: sports, place and country, other names, season, how it is today for each sport (the website's rating, a 1-5 score and the reasons, from Open-Meteo), the current wind, snow or sea, the spot's features (lifts, slopes, altitudes, beach, dive site…) and its official links. Exact name matching: if the name is not exact it says so and suggests similar spots. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

spot.description: The spot: its name (“Cerro Catedral”), another of its names (“Catedral”), its Siami slug (“cerro-catedral”) or its page URL.

sport.description: Only this sport, when the spot has several.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish, the default), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: The forecast of a spot for the next days, as its page shows it: for each day, sunrise and sunset, tides and kite hours where they apply, and for the morning, afternoon and night the sky, temperatures (top, middle and base of ski resorts), wind and gusts with direction, chance of rain, snowfall, freezing level and waves. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

spot.description: The spot: its name (“Cerro Catedral”), another of its names (“Catedral”), its Siami slug (“cerro-catedral”) or its page URL.

sport.description: The sport, when the spot has several (the forecast differs). Default: the spot's first sport.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish, the default), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: best_spots_today
tools.description: Where conditions are best today, tomorrow or this weekend (Siami's “Where it's best” on /weather): spots ranked by their 1-5 score, with the website's rating and the wind, snow or waves of each, optionally for one sport, one country or around a spot. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

sport.description: The sport: snow (snowboard), ski, kite (kitesurf), diving or surf.

country.description: A country: its name in English, Spanish or Italian (“Argentina”, “Spain”, “Italia”) or its ISO code (“AR”).

near_spot.description: Only spots around this one (name, slug or URL).

radius_km.description: Radius around the spot in km, 1-300. Default 30.

when.description: today, tomorrow or weekend. Default today.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish, the default), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Schools, rentals, shops, dive centres, guides, surf camps and clubs listed on Siami's harbour, near a spot (by distance) or in a country, optionally for one sport and one kind, with what you can do there (buy, book, rent, train) and their page. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

near_spot.description: Businesses around this spot (name, slug or URL), nearest first.

radius_km.description: Radius around the spot in km, 1-300. Default 30.

country.description: A country: its name in English, Spanish or Italian (“Argentina”, “Spain”, “Italia”) or its ISO code (“AR”).

sport.description: The sport: snow (snowboard), ski, kite (kitesurf), diving or surf.

kind.description: Only one kind: school, rental, shop, guide, dive_center, surf_camp, gym, trainer, club or lodging.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish, the default), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: The countries with spots on Siami, most spots first, with how many spots each has per sport and the page that lists them. Optionally only for one sport. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

sport.description: The sport: snow (snowboard), ski, kite (kitesurf), diving or surf.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish, the default), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Snowboard, ski, kitesurf, diving and surf competitions on Siami: upcoming (default) or past, optionally for one sport, one country, around a spot or by words in the title, with dates, venue, series and their page. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

sport.description: The sport: snow (snowboard), ski, kite (kitesurf), diving or surf.

country.description: A country: its name in English, Spanish or Italian (“Argentina”, “Spain”, “Italia”) or its ISO code (“AR”).

near_spot.description: Only events around this spot (name, slug or URL).

query.description: Words in the event's title (“Freeride World Tour”, “King of the Air”).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish, the default), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches Siami by name, without accents or capitals: spots (by name or place), schools and shops, athletes (their sport, country and best-known result) and upcoming events, each with a line of context and its page. Use it when you are not sure of a name. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish, the default), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.
